title: Off the Bucket List Grayt 30A Vacations
description_expanded: AboutOff the Bucket List ~ 45 Wakulla Lane ~ Seaside FL 32459 Need a last-minute stay? Please call our office at 844-941-1213 to make last-minute bookings via telephone, as availability within the next 7-nights will not show on calendar. We do not allow online bookings within 7-nights/one week of an arrival date. 30% Discount off Spring Rates! 4-night minimum with flexible arrival/departure days. Valid on new bookings only for stays completed prior to May 22nd. Discount is reflected in online pricing. 20% Discount off Summer 2026! 4-nt minimum with flexible arrival/departure days. Valid on new bookings only for stays completed prior to August 8th! Discount is reflected in online pricing. Off the Bucket List is a luxurious, newly renovated 3,593 sf home located in iconic Seaside! Never before rented, this elegant cottage has been beautifully restored without losing its Victorian inspired charm. With 4 bedrooms/3 full baths/2 half baths, Off the Bucket List will comfortably sleep up to 10 guests in spacious bedrooms, dual living spaces, and multiple porches. Off the Bucket List features a tower deck with expansive views of Seaside and glimpses of the Gulf of Mexico. Located across from Croquet Lawn, guests can enjoy a 30-second walk to the Seaside Family Pool, Adult Pool, Fitness Center, and playground. Just a 6-minute walk will bring you to the beautiful, emerald Seaside beaches. This stunning home is truly a unique find in Seaside!! PLEASE NOTE: Neither golf carts nor on-street parking are allowed in Seaside. Guests have accessibility to 3 pools, 6 tennis courts (fees apply), croquet courts, private fitness center and multiple parks. You are within walking distance to the delectable delights on Air Stream Row, as well as several other amazing local restaurants, retail establishments, quaint gourmet grocery, chapel and artist galleries along theTown Center and Ruskin Place. NOTE - we automatically include the cost of Swim and Fitness passes to our Seaside reservations. This charge is optional with Grayt 30A Vacations. If you DO NOT want access to any of the community pools and/or the fitness center during your stay, please call us directly and immediately after booking if you would like to remove this charge. Once removed from the stay, this charge cannot be added back on. Charge varies and is dependent on length of stay. Ten wristbands and two parking passes are left inside the home for guest use. If any wristbands and/or parking passes are missing upon departure, an immediate replacement charge of $150 + tax per item will be charged to guest. First Level: Laundry Room.1 Bedroom. 1 Full Bath. Powder Room. Living room. Covered Porch. #1 En-suite Bedroom has a King bed, walk-in shower, double vanity, walk-in closet. Second Level: Kitchen. Dining table seats 8. Island seating for 5. Bar seating for 3. Wet Bar. Powder Room. Living Room. Reading Nook. Covered Porch with Day Bed. Third Level: 3 Bedrooms. 2 Full Baths. #2 En-Suite Bedroom has a King bed, walk-in shower, double vanity, claw foot tub, walk-in closet, sitting room. #3 Bedroom has a Queen bed. Full jack-and-jill bathroom shared between #3 and #4 bedrooms, walk-in shower, separate vanities. #4 Bedroom has two built-in bunks (4 twins). Amenities: Business Features Wireless Internet (password secured) Entertainment Features 11 TV’s Distinctive Features 5 Minute Walk to Seaside Town Center Gulf view Luxurious new remodel with high-end finishes Community pools (3), fitness center, tennis Bed, bath and kitchen linens provided (except beach towels) General Features Parking for 1 vehicle (add'l parking available throughout resort) 2 King beds, 1 Queen bed, 2 Bunk beds (4 Twins) 3 Full bathrooms, 2 half bathrooms, iron, ironing board, hair dryer, outdoor covered and open porch, porch furniture, day bed, lookout tower. Linens provided. No Smoking. No Pets. Kitchen Features Fully equipped kitchen with brand new Electrolux and Bosch appliances, farmhouse sink, marble countertops, imported AGA Swedish Range Cooker, granite wet bar countertops, wine refrigerator, ice maker, drip coffee maker, microwave, dishwasher, toaster, blender, washer, dryer. *Please note - Cookware larger than 9"x13" will NOT fit in any of the AGA range compartments. Area Features Timpoochee Trail (30A bike path) WaterColor (1/2 mile) Grayton Beach (2 miles) State Parks (Tops’l, Grayton Beach, Deer Lake)
